title.zh: Shinhan, SBI make Japan-Korea tourist spending a test case for yen stablecoins
title.en: Shinhan, SBI make Japan-Korea tourist spending a test case for yen stablecoins

current_state.zh: Shinhan Card signed an agreement with SBI VC Trade and SBI XDC Network APAC to pilot yen stablecoin card payments, wallet-to-wallet transfers and Korea-Japan cross-border trade settlement, alongside AML and fraud-detection safeguards.
current_state.en: Shinhan Card signed an agreement with SBI VC Trade and SBI XDC Network APAC to pilot yen stablecoin card payments, wallet-to-wallet transfers and Korea-Japan cross-border trade settlement, alongside AML and fraud-detection safeguards.
